interpretation: Retrospective exploratory evaluation; cohort summaries/outcomes were previously inspected and training CV was repeatedly explored. Not a pristine prospective or confirmatory test.
selection: Highest mean five-fold sigmoid-calibrated AP; tie: lowest mean Brier, then model name. Selection uses existing training CV only; selected CV score is optimistic after selection.
features: Original 33 predictors reduced to 30 by existing pipeline; original missingness flags and geography retained. No enriched features adopted.

fit.tuning: Existing TUNING_GRIDS and tune_on_training; grouped inner AP; full training cohort only
fit.calibration: Existing calibration_training_scores(train, model, outer_fold=0), then fit_calibrators on training OOF scores only
fit.preprocessing: Refit all learned preprocessing, including inner grade KNN selection, within each training partition. Full-data final fit uses training cohort only.

cohorts.primary: Later-wave children from households absent in training; exclude all shared people and households using IDs only
cohorts.secondary: Later-wave children absent as people in training; shared households allowed and disclosed
cohorts.all_later_rows: Descriptive context only, not independent test performance

policy.selection: floor(capacity*N), descending probability, existing SHA-256 identity tie-breaker; never use labels for allocation
policy.scope: Apply policy separately to each eligible cohort; evaluate subgroup errors using that cohort allocation, without reranking within subgroups
policy.deployment: 20% is a comparison assumption, not a confirmed budget. No deployment or guaranteed high-recall claim. Do not select a capacity by later-wave outcomes.

subgroups.region_risk: High if training-cohort regional dropout rate exceeds training overall dropout rate; otherwise low. Freeze region membership from training only; unseen/missing region separate. Do not redefine from temporal outcomes.
subgroups.small_groups: Report all counts; mark n<30 or events<5 as sparse, descriptive only. Undefined metrics remain missing. No selective omission or subgroup performance ranking.

comparators: Existing age/sex demographic baseline with training-only calibration
Analytic random-selection expectation at identical capacity
geography_missingness: Report existing training ablations beside temporal/regional findings. These ablations do not themselves demonstrate temporal robustness; any later temporal ablation needs a separately frozen extension, with no promotion based on test results.
uncertainty: Use 1000 district-cluster bootstrap replicates, seed 20261025, for descriptive intervals on fixed predictions and allocations; no refitting or reranking. Disclose few-cluster and zero-event replicates; intervals do not cover model-selection uncertainty.
reporting: Show each family, calibration sensitivity and cohort, internal CV versus temporal differences, prevalence shifts, subgroup counts and false alarms/misses. Do not replace the candidate after seeing test results. Predictions apply to observable children; attrition limits generalization.
pending: Fit frozen models on training data and evaluate temporal predictions
Explain selected Extra Trees model separately
Synchronize final report and decision log
